e: […] the faithful service he gave was pearl cast before mean, gutless, brainless, up-jumped swine […]
The man was an upjumped peasant with delusions of his own importance.

s.d: Having no correspondence.
A room housing a pump, especially a room or structure at a spa where mineral water is drawn from a spring and consumed, formerly often serving as a venue for polite socializing and conversation.
e: [E]ven the German visitors at the baths honored me by drinking my health in the pump-room.

s.d: A method in which the electrical components are mounted directly onto the surface of a printed circuit board.
e: Coordinate term: through-hole technology
